sections.changelog:
1.10.0

  • Programmatic SEO city hubs: /city/{city}/{contractors|projects|properties}/ auto-render, real-data (counts + cached deal stats + top cards), CollectionPage+ItemList JSON-LD, dedicated sitemap. Floor: ≥5 cards per hub or 404; weaker hubs (5-9 cards) noindex,follow. 2026 best-practice: ≥25-30% unique data per page, quality over volume, anti-doorway compliant.
  • Rich media: 3D tour (Kuula JS embed; auto-extracts post id) + video (oEmbed) + floorplan image/PDF in a tabbed block on property singles. tour_url/video_url/floorplan_url REST meta. VideoObject JSON-LD when video present. Matterport replaced with Kuula per Zillow's Oct 2025 vendor change.

1.9.0

  • AI features (compliance-first): listing description generator with HUD Fair-Housing + IL חוק איסור הפליה guardrails in the prompt + post-generation steering-phrase scan (Hebrew+English) that holds flagged drafts for editor review; natural-language Hebrew property search (LLM→structured filter→WP_Query) with deterministic regex fallback + 1h cache; pluggable nadlan_llm_request adapter (default Anthropic, gated on NADLAN_LLM_API_KEY).

1.8.0

  • Saved searches + email alerts: nadlan_saved_search CPT, double opt-in (token email), daily cron matches new listings against confirmed searches, [nadlan_save_search] form, rate-limited public REST.

1.7.0

  • Deal-history + AVM + neighborhood layer: cached wp_nadlan_deals table, comparable-sales AVM with confidence/FSD score + explainable range (degrades gracefully when sparse), neighborhood stats, GET /nadlan/v1/avm, POST /nadlan/v1/deals-ingest (Cowork-verified endpoints slot in via nadlan_deals_remote filter), on-listing valuation block + [nadlan_home_value] seller lead funnel.

1.6.0

  • Listing engagement UX: similar listings, favorites (REST + localStorage fallback), view counter + days-on-market badges, ₪ mortgage calculator [nadlan_mortgage], schedule-viewing + WhatsApp CTA (reuses lead endpoint).

1.5.0

  • Directory cards: project + professional (contractor/service-provider) meta + free-card claim funnel (claim REST endpoint, admin approval, owner edits own card via map_meta_cap).
  • Importer: pulls רשם הקבלנים (~14k) + התחדשות עירונית (~938) from data.gov.il CKAN (idempotent upsert by source_id); admin dashboard buttons + WP-CLI `wp nadlan import` + REST import-enrich for the Cowork/ChatGPT enrichment pipeline.
  • Auction engine: timed auctions with proxy/auto-bid, hidden reserve, soft-close anti-sniping, buyer's premium; custom wp_nadlan_bids table; auctions/v1 REST (state, bids, place-bid with per-auction GET_LOCK).
  • SEO: JSON-LD per card (GeneralContractor/ApartmentComplex/RealEstateListing) + thin-content noindex guard so stub cards never index or cannibalize until enriched.

1.4.0

  • GA4 direct tag (G-G3QRV5646E) emitted in wp_head so the owner's GA4 property starts collecting (site was only tagging GT-W6VHT5TK via Site Kit). Guarded by NADLAN_GA4_HARDCODE constant; consolidate onto one tag/property later to avoid double-counting.

1.3.0

  • robots.txt via robots_txt filter with Sitemap reference.
  • Disable wptexturize on titles/content/excerpts (fixes en-dash auto-conversion AI-tell).

1.2.1

  • Strip ALL <meta name=generator> (including Site Kit's, not just WP core).
  • Property meta fields exposed for REST writes (listing_type, price, rooms, sqm, lat/lng, sponsored flags, etc.).
  • Healthcheck augmented via proper filter; now reports indexnow.key_present + recent_pings for verification.

1.2.0

  • Self-hosted auto-update via plugin-update-checker.
  • IndexNow auto-ping on save_post.
  • Catalog CPTs (property/project/professional).
  • Public lead REST endpoint.
  • Generator meta removed.
